simple.summary: גַּבְרִיאֵל (Gabrîyʼêl) means Gabriel , an archangel First listed occurrence: Dan 8 16.

definitions.full: H1403. Gabriel גַּבְרִיאֵל proper name, masculine (man of El ) an arch-angel Dan 8:16 ; 9:21 (compare Luke 1:19 ). גבשׁ ( be firm, massive , compare Assyrian gâbašu, be thick massive , Zim BP 76, & derivatives ; compare also Aramaic גַּבֵּשׁ ; Pa`el heap up & גַּבְשׁוּשִׁית height, hill ).
